svg.text: Checkout · Customer Portal · Stripe Webhook Sync · Write Enforcement
B. STRIPE WEBHOOK SYNC — POST /webhooks/stripe (async, Stripe-initiated)
active / trialing → active / trialing (no plan change)
outcome values returned: "processed" | "duplicate" | "ignored" — always respond 200 to Stripe
C. WRITE ENFORCEMENT — called by projects.service on every write
fallback: status='active' if no sub row
called only on POST (create), not reads
Called from projects.service on every write path
Uses req.db (app-role pool, RLS active) for quota count
Uses ownerPool for billing state (organizations table)
D. CUSTOMER PORTAL — POST /v1/billing/portal (self-service plan management)
as checkout, reuses cust. if exists)
AppError (notFound, conflict, etc.) → passes through as-is
Any Stripe SDK error → wrapped as 502 badGateway
(no Stripe internals ever reach the client — R14.5)
Webhook: non-2xx → Stripe retries. Event NOT recorded as
processed until after successful Stripe refetch + DB commit.
